{{Quote|It sounds absurd, sure, but you can't deny that the Jedi are getting more and more coverage in the holomedia. Maybe it's the Republic. Maybe it's the Council. It's as if someone is looking for a poster boy, and I don't think you can do much better than Skywalker.|AndroosinLiann|<ref name="HoloNet News 15:01:03">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}}</ref>}}
'''AndroosinLiann''' was a [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] media figure who hosted the talk show ''[[Essence]]''<ref name="Stark Vets" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Stark Vets" /> In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="23 BBY date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_4.html|Stark Veterans Blast Amidala}} is dated to 13:2:28 in the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]], which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> AndroosinLiann interviewed [[Laslo Dorits]], the spokesbeing for the [[Stark Veteran Assembly]], during [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]'s ongoing campaign against the militarization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Dorits took issue specifically with Amidala's assertion that war was the product of cowardice.<ref name="Stark Vets" />

AndroosinLiann was still host of ''Essence''<ref name="HoloNet News 15:01:03" /> two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY date">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}} is dated to 15:01:03 by the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]], which corresponds to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> and commented on the increase of coverage of members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[holomedia]]. The host specifically cited [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had just been named a [[Warrior of the Infinite]] for his actions in the [[Battle of Virujansi]], as a "poster boy" for the war.<ref name="HoloNet News 15:01:03" />
